observed_boundaries: Initial Water4 candidate read shared stock twice; another worker could consume it between reads, producing an invalid zero quantity. The native simulator rejected that trial. Snapshot repair uses a positive local amount; remaining races produce paid failure warnings, never free watering.
Snake nursery is faster on mean, with ordinary seed2 1.238690250 seconds slower; the other two seeds improve. Do not claim every paired ordinary sample is faster.

Mushroom transfer includes resident partitions, measured thickness, low-platform matching, and skipping low-yield final layers. Full-route savings also include changed timing and random consumption; they are not wholly attributable to spawn counts.
Eager helper/cache initialization changes upstream timing. The adopted Dynamo helpers are defined within ur_dynamite_stock; its layout initialization is charged when mining Dynamite starts.
